instruction: Candid lifestyle photograph, medium shot. Two men stand close together outdoors against a grey corrugated metal wall. On the left, the fair-skinned man in the teal t-shirt and pinkish-grey open shirt (R2) is positioned with his back partially to the camera, leaning his left arm casually over his friend's shoulder. On the right, the Black man in the light blue open shirt over a white t-shirt (R1) stands facing him, looking at him with a relaxed expression. The scene is captured in soft, diffused daylight, emphasizing the cool grey tones of the metallic background.
